derivation: the main flow works. 1 thing in the build does not match what you asked for — the mix-ratio status line (t-3-ac1) — and none of them is from the PRD itself: worth reading before you merge.

criteria.text: The board shows every recorded grout batch in one list on the page.
criteria.note: One list under the header carries all three recorded batches, a line each — B-1041 · sanded · charcoal, B-1042 · unsanded · alabaster, B-1043 · epoxy · slate.

criteria.text: A new batch can be added from the board itself, without leaving the page.
criteria.note: The add row is right there on the board — a 'new batch code' input with an ADD BATCH button beside it, no navigating away.

criteria.text: The board names itself in a header so the tiler knows what he is looking at.
criteria.note: An orange band across the top names it GROUT TRACKER (background rgb(224,138,60)), full width at the very top, just as your drawing has it.

criteria.text: The batch list is the first thing under the header.
criteria.note: The list sits directly beneath the header — the header ends at y=51 and the list starts at y=71, nothing between them.

criteria.text: An ADD BATCH button sits to the right of the input.
criteria.note: The ADD BATCH button is to the right of the input, at x=1293 where the input runs from x=20 to about x=1283 — exactly the order your drawing shows.

criteria.text: A status line beneath the add row shows the current mix ratio.
criteria.note: Your drawing has an orange mix-ratio line sitting beneath the add row. It isn't there at all — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer, and the readout confirms no status line is present.
Nothing on screen can settle this, but your own suite covers it and it passes.

criteria.text: The export writes valid CSV with a header row.
criteria.note: Nothing on screen can settle this, and your suite does not cover it — it ran only two tests, 'renders the header' and 'batches survive a restart', neither of which touches the CSV export. So I could not check this.

gaps.title: the mix-ratio status line
gaps.expected: an orange status line beneath the add row showing the current mix ratio and how many batches are open
gaps.saw: nothing there — below the add row the page goes straight to the footer, and no status line is present

alsoChecked: The ADD button is teal (background rgb(90,166,184)); your drawing leaves the button colour to the builder, so I'm treating that as your call.
There's a footer reading 'grout tracker · sandbox build' at the bottom; your drawing says nothing about a footer, so that's the builder's call, not a fault.
summary: Captain, the board runs and reads well: the orange GROUT TRACKER header is up top, all three batches sit in one list directly under it, and the add row with its ADD BATCH button to the right lets him add without leaving the page. One thing from the drawing is missing — the orange mix-ratio status line beneath the add row simply isn't there; below the add row the page drops straight to the footer. Persistence is covered by your own tests and passes; the CSV export has no test and no screen surface, so I couldn't check it.
